zh: 飞书、Telegram、Discord 的本人网页私聊各显示一次完整文字回复。QQ、微信沿用更早版本的真实往返记录，本轮网页收发仍待验证。
五个已接入渠道的语音准备检查通过。实际语音、媒体回复和本版本重启后收发等待逐项验证。
en: One complete private text reply was observed in each of Lark, Telegram and Discord web chats. QQ and Weixin have earlier real-account round trips, with this version's web checks pending.
Speech readiness passed in the five configured channels. Real speech, media delivery and post-restart replies for this version remain pending.

zh: 订阅切换按发起请求时的版本核对，QQ 和飞书保留在途发送的真实回执。
串行队列等待前一条的回调重试，超限旧附件单独挂起，历史记录较多时仍会更新新消息的处理提示。
状态页显示最近入站、dot 回调、回复提交和平台回执。一次目录核对复用经过鉴权的运行时目录。
提醒正文到期后禁用重试，未核对的发送结果和去重标识可在正文清理后保留。
LINE 本地语音生成最长 60 秒的 M4A。私有迁移工具检查所选 LINE 媒体配置及其引用的密钥。
en: Late callback responses are scoped to the subscription revision that initiated them. QQ and Lark retain the outcome of in-flight provider sends.
Serial queues wait for earlier callback retries. Oversized retained attachments are held separately, and recent processing feedback remains available with a large history.
The status page shows recent input, dot callback, reply submission and provider acknowledgement. Catalog inspection reuses the authenticated runtime snapshot.
Expired reminder text is unavailable for retry. Unresolved delivery outcomes and deduplication markers survive content cleanup.
LINE speech produces M4A up to 60 seconds. The private migration tool includes the selected LINE media configuration and its referenced keys.

zh: 本版本的验收采用合成输入和网络夹具。LINE 的 M4A 回归使用实际 FFmpeg 编码，并通过本地媒体发布器检查。
真实账号往返和生产切换等待按本版本验收。0.10.1 的网页私聊证据保留在对应版本记录。
en: This version is checked with synthetic input and network fixtures. The LINE M4A regression uses real FFmpeg encoding and the local media publisher.
Real-account round trips and production activation await verification for this build. The 0.10.1 web-chat results are recorded under that version.
